hub.sub: Engineers and buyers search by specification, shortlist suppliers and ask for quotes. We build the search, proof and enquiry path for that journey.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: B2B manufacturing marketing is the work of getting industrial buyers, engineers and procurement teams to find your plant by specification, trust your capability and send a qualified request for quote. It combines search by product and process, case studies, a clear RFQ path and a CRM that tracks enquiries to orders.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) markets manufacturers and industrial suppliers in India, building the website, search, content and paid media that feed a sales team.

points.title: RFQs that qualify
points.text: Forms and CRM tracking that separate real requests from noise.

paras: An engineer or purchase manager usually searches by part, material, standard or process, reads datasheets and compares several suppliers. Several people sign off, and the cycle can be long. Distributors, dealers and trade events also play a part.
A site that lists products without specifications, certifications or proof gives them little to work with.
blocks.cap: A capability page explained to a buying team.

blocks.h: The problem that keeps coming back
paras: Many manufacturers depend on referrals and dealers, have a brochure website, and receive enquiries that are unqualified or wrongly specified. Sales spends time on requests that never close.
The fix is to publish the specifications buyers search, show proof, ask the right questions on the RFQ form and track what becomes an order. See the B2B marketing overview and the guides.

callout.title: Cost of a qualified lead.
callout.text: We judge the work on the cost of a qualified enquiry and the orders it leads to, not on clicks.

leaks.note: Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.
leaks.lede: Each stage below is where an industrial buyer is lost or a request goes to waste, and the work that fixes it.

stages.breaks: A site that lists a catalogue but not what buyers search.
stages.why: Buyers search by part, material, process and standard, not by company name.
stages.does: We build product, process and application pages around those searches. See SEO.

stages.breaks: A brochure site with no proof.
stages.why: Buyers need to see capacity, certifications, quality process and similar jobs before they quote.
stages.does: We build capability pages and case studies that a buying team can forward. See website development.

stages.k: Reach buyers while the need is live
stages.why: Paid search and professional-network ads reach buyers when a need is live.
stages.does: We run Google Ads and lead generation campaigns by product and region.

stages.why: Without drawing, quantity, material or timeline, sales cannot tell a real request from noise.
stages.does: We design RFQ forms and landing pages that ask the right questions. See CRO.

stages.k: Follow up and track to orders
stages.why: Long cycles need follow-up and a record of what becomes an order.
stages.does: We connect forms to your CRM, set follow-up steps and report enquiry to order.
